title: The North Pole Expedition Lost for 33 Years
topic: Andrée's 1897 North Pole balloon expedition, lost for 33 years
format_note: User-specified ~35 s historical Short (115 words, 34.7 s, fast narrator). Overrides the 50-60 s explainer targets on purpose. Strindberg's camera, the film tin and the diary are drawn larger than scale so they read on a phone.
mechanism: A steerless hydrogen balloon lost its drag ropes at takeoff and iced up in fog, dropping three men on the pack ice far short of the pole; they died on White Island and their camp, diaries and still-developable film were found 33 years later by seal hunters.

beats.hook: The silk balloon rushes at the lens over the pack ice; the three men in the basket; Strindberg's camera flash; the basket slams into an ice ridge
beats.story: Andrée, Strindberg and Frænkel lift off from the plank hangar on Danes Island
beats.rise: No engine, just wind: the Eagle sails north over the ice
beats.twist: 33 years later a sealing ship's crew walks up White Island and digs a boat out of the snow (event)
beats.mechanism: Labelled physical props: DRAG ROPES snapping off, ice crust on the envelope, sled with the men, the film tin in the darkroom developing a photo, a 93 counter on the print rack
beats.ending: The developed photo of the balloon on the ice turns into the opening shot; loops back to the balloon over the ice

seed.what: Strindberg's camera (the film the ending depends on)
